'''Hera's A-wing'''<ref name="Art Gallery">{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/the-protector-of-concord-dawn-concept-art-gallery|text="The Protector of Concord Dawn" Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|slide 9}}</ref> was an [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor]] used by the [[Spectres|rebel]] [[pilot]] [[Hera Syndulla]]. Syndulla was the [[Phoenix Leader|leader]] of [[Phoenix Squadron]], a [[squadron]] of A-wing [[Starfighter|fighters]] that was a part of the early rebellion against the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="The Protector of Concord Dawn" />

==History==
[[File:HeraSyndulla-SWZ83.png|thumb|left|250px|Hera piloting her A-wing over Concord Dawn]]
In [[3 BBY]], Syndulla flew her A-wing alongside other Phoenix Squadron pilots in the [[Concord Dawn system]], hoping to gain permission from the [[Journeyman Protector|Mandalorian Protectors]] to pass through the [[Star system|system]] as part of a new [[hyperspace route]] to the [[planet]] [[Lothal]], however the rebels were [[Dogfight over Concord Dawn|attacked]] by the Protectors, who were working with the Empire, leaving Syndulla's fighter badly damaged.<ref name="The Protector of Concord Dawn" />
